verdict.rationale: Undermind's homepage shows plan tiers differing on usage limits ("10x higher usage limits", "Unlimited workspaces, files, and paper libraries") and mentions team centralized billing, so plan differentiation is documented. Only a community post gives an actual price ($20/month), and no first-party page states prices or concrete limits. Missing for 10: first-party published plan prices, concrete usage-limit numbers per plan (e.g., searches/month), free-tier/trial terms, enterprise pricing details, independent corroboration of current pricing.
